subject: Request: Playground credit bump for eval — FathomAI
messages:
From: Ellie Zhao <ellie.zhao@fathomai.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@fathomai.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Playground credit bump for eval — FathomAI

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team ran a larger end-to-end pass over the weekend and hit some token limits in our sandbox. Our current trial credits will expire in 5 days and we still have two integration tests and an internal benchmark to finish.

Would Redwood be open to a one-time playground credit bump so we can complete the final tests? We’re asking for $750 in additional credits and a 30–45 day grace window on the expiration so the tests don’t get cut off mid-run. We can provide a short note from procurement if needed.

Attached is a screenshot of our usage graph showing the spike and the account org id: fathomai-org-72.

Appreciate any help — we’d like to push this into a small pilot in production after the tests.

Best,
Ellie Zhao
Head of Platform
FathomAI
(Attachment: usage_screenshot.png)

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Zhao <ellie.zhao@fathomai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Playground credit bump for eval — FathomAI

Hi Ellie — thanks for the detail and the screenshot. Totally get needing a short runway to finish the end-to-end tests.

Process-wise, we can issue a one-time self-serve credit grant from the console but it needs a quick approval from our sales ops manager for the amount/expiry. If it helps speed things up you can reply with the org id (you included it) and a single-sentence confirmation that this is for evaluation only (non-production). Once I have signoff I’ll issue the grant and share the console link with the grant id and expiry.

Tentative plan: $750 one-time, 45-day expiry from issuance. If that works I’ll loop Ben for approval now.

Thanks — J

--
Jasmine Liu

jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0143

I’m attaching the authorization token you’ll need to mint the grant via the console API. Please confirm once it’s live and paste the grant id in the HubSpot record.

-Ben

- Grant ID: GRANT-9X2F
